newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aros cuts Jones Medical.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aros cuts Jones Medical.

text.p: -- Aros Securitis analyst David Maris he downgraded Jones Medical Industries Inc to reduce from buy.

-- "Based on recent discussions with management and analysis of anticipated sources of growth from 1996 results and beyond, we are increasingly concerned regarding Jones' base business growth and the impact of recent acquisitions," Maris said in a report.
-- The stock was flat at 29-1/4 in early trading.
